summary: St. Joe National Forest L-4 tower site listed in 1934 and destroyed in 1952; no source we read describes what remains today.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1952; no source we read describes the site now.

events.note: L-4 tower listed about half a mile northwest of the summit; the sources do not say when it was built

evidence.supports: 1934 L-4 tower about half a mile northwest of the summit
evidence.quote: 1934: L-4 tower 1/2 mile northwest of summit.

evidence.supports: patrol points half a mile and three-quarters of a mile east on the ridge
evidence.quote: Patrol points 1/2 mile and 3/4 mile east on ridgetop.

evidence.supports: L-4 tower listed for 1934 on the Idaho site
evidence.quote: L-4 Tower 1/2 mile northwest of summit

evidence.supports: patrol points half a mile and three-quarters of a mile east on the ridge, on the Idaho site
evidence.quote: Patrol Points: 1/2 mile and 3/4 mile east or ridgetop
We don't yet have a documented staffing history for this lookout.

notes_for_editor: Both sites agree on the 1934 L-4 tower and the 1952 destruction. Neither says how the tower was lost, and no source describes the site now. The Idaho page is labelled drive-up, which we record without judging current access. A 2023 social media post (tw_firelookout) says a July visit found no photos of this lookout and mentions three towers on the ridge; it is too vague to use and is not cited. Do not confuse with the Pegleg Mountain lookouts in California (us-ca-pegleg-mountain). The sources call the structure an L-4 tower but do not define the term.
